# ARCH-25: A feed-forward term models the vehicle, not a setting that shapes the command

- Each feed-forward term comes from an estimate of the vehicle, never from a parameter that shapes the command (a speed limit, a time constant, an expo). Whatever the two disagree by is left to an integrator, which carries it through every transient.

Confirmed 2026-11-14. Part of the root playbook, under [Architectural Principles](../claude/CLAUDE.md#architectural-principles). [All architectural rules](../README.md#architectural-rules)
